title: Fixed local tolerance does not select a global order parameter
statement: On a periodic4ell by4ell ferromagnetic torus, translated mixtures of alternating width-ell +/- vertical stripes have energy/site1/ell, ZZ horizontal distance r<=ell equal1-2r/ell, and exact global M^2/N^2=0 while symmetric ground mixture gives1. Patch horizontal diameter R<ell differs by TV<=R/ell or trace norm<=2R/ell. For fixed patches/energy density errors approach0 along this sequence while global normalized magnetization-square stays0; this does NOT contradict local-state convergence or exact phase certification. Producer exact ell4,8,16,32 gives distance2 correlations0,.5,.75,.875. Dressed XXZ/Clifford novelty attempt rejected as known-model reduction; defect-gating still elementary via ordinary PSD domination. Source-inspected structured NPA/QMBCertify Wang et al arXiv2604.01555v1 ground-state commutator identities and matrix optimality positivity are valid; empirical omission in frustrated2D solver problems establishes neither invalidity nor root cause. Reported10x10 SDP-.510813 vs older-.514628 and DMRGupper-.4988 are FINITE model results, not infinite phase guarantees;16x16 spin-correlation bounds straddle0. No large-solver/field experiment or advantage performed. Next earned operation is actual uniform connected dimer response bound in selected symmetry sector, or controlled exact RK representation with PAID Hamiltonian/observable error. Current N1077 successor rejects broad variation advantage; old historical pin is provenance, not evidence of stale default guide.

requires: Even periodic L square spin-1/2 J1-J2 at alpha=1/2; D_L=sum (-1)^x S_xy dot S_x+1,y; e(h)=lim lambda_min(H-hD)/L^2; m_D=-e-prime(0+). Observable norm density <=3/4. Positive m_D selects only columnar pi,0 bond order. Zero excludes only this component, not vertical/plaquette/topological/gapless alternatives.

Each positive control has its own exact sector/model assumptions; source-faithful quantum dimer basis is orthogonal and has specified positive rational edge amplitudes. Finite-field lower bound needs independently proved uniform field/volume curvature modulus.
